pages.text: The $(bold)Curse Crafting Ritual$() uses curse power itself as an ingredient, together with old-god items, to make special gear.$(br2)$(bold)Structure (5x5x3, Gheloth Ore at the centre of layer 2)$():$(li)Layer 1 (one below the ore): $(bold)modifier worktable$() in the centre, $(bold)obsidian$() in the four cardinal directions, $(bold)crying obsidian$() and $(bold)soul sand$() alternating around the ring (corners are free)$(li)Layer 2 (the ore level): eight $(bold)seared brick walls$() (scorched also works), eight $(bold)soul fire$() blocks (lit on the soul sand)$(li)Layer 3: one $(bold)seared lantern$() above every wall and above the ore (9 lanterns)

When the structure is complete you hear $(bold)thunder$().$(br2)The lantern directly above the ore is the $(bold)core slot$() (put the recipe core item there, and take the product from it); the other eight are $(bold)material slots$().$(br2)Right-click a material lantern while holding an item to place it (it floats, has no collision, bobs and spins like a dropped item); right-click again to take it back.

$(bold)Starting$(): once every material is placed, hold the $(bold)core old-god item$() the recipe asks for and right-click the lantern $(bold)above the ore$().$(br2)$(bold)During the ritual$() all items gather three blocks above the ore, constantly emitting item-coloured break particles, and a $(bold)deep purple particle beam$() links you to the cluster, $(bold)draining 10 curse power per tick$() from you (first the curse core pool, then the $(l:bottle)bottle$(), then a $(l:vault)vault$(); soul energy is never used).

$(bold)Finishing$(): when the curse is fully absorbed the cluster explodes and the product floats on the lantern above the ore; right-click to take it.$(br2)$(bold)Interruptions$(): not enough curse power, moving more than 16 blocks away, breaking the structure, or touching a lantern mid-ritual. On interruption every material floats back to its own lantern, $(bold)nothing is consumed$().$(br2)Recipes live in $(bold)data/tinkersnewlife/recipes/curse_craft/$(), and can also be browsed in JEI (catalyst: Gheloth Ore).
